north_star: Week-2 activated retention >= 30%, where activated means >=3 readiness-adjusted sessions or recovery actions in 14 days.
doctrine: TRANSFORMFIT-DOCTRINE.md L1 Coaching and L2 Behavioral

personas.name: Motivator
personas.behavior: Warm, forward, effort-noticing, and consistency-celebrating with specific session evidence.

personas.name: Analyst
personas.behavior: Precise, trend-driven, anomaly-aware, and grounded in session metrics.

personas.name: Challenger
personas.behavior: Direct, high-bar, evidence-led confrontation without shame.

workflow_states.trigger: User opens the app before any completed session.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Reduces first-session drop-off and starts the 3-in-14 activation path.

workflow_states.trigger: Soreness, low sleep, low readiness, or recovery-only recommendation.
workflow_states.decision: Count recovery as a kept promise when it matches readiness.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Prevents shame churn and preserves return behavior inside the activation window.

workflow_states.trigger: User completes a session or opens Progress/Proof.
workflow_states.decision: Explain volume, recovery wins, comeback days, and next best action without body ranking.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Turns completed work into retention proof and a next-action loop.

workflow_states.trigger: User has an active workout session with non-coasting effort, even when completed history exists.
workflow_states.decision: Keep the coach focused on the next in-session action: use the target, take rest, and log the next clean set before interpreting progress.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Improves Week-2 activated retention by reducing mid-workout cognitive load and preventing the live logger from drifting into post-session summary mode.

workflow_states.trigger: Repeated low-effort sessions, rapid volume jump, or no recovery wins.
workflow_states.decision: Challenge the pattern with data and a bounded next action.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Protects sustainable training quality so activation compounds beyond week 2.

workflow_states.trigger: User reports pain, sharp pain, an ache, twinge, aggravation, or worsening symptom in a session debrief.
workflow_states.decision: Suppress load progression, choose a pain-free variation, and keep stop/modify/seek-care boundaries explicit without giving medical diagnosis.
workflow_states.north_star_trace: Protects trust and retention by preventing unsafe coaching at the moment a user is most likely to churn or get hurt.

proof_obligations: Every generated coach message must pass message_rule_lint.
Every surfaced copy block must pass doctrine_lint.
Every AI-assisted recommendation must expose deterministic inputs and confidence.
Every public/share surface must remain body-neutral and opt-in.
No coaching workflow ships from a model-only claim; deterministic gate output is required.
Pain or injury notes must suppress progression until a pain-free variation is selected.
